🇲🇽🛢️ <u>MEXICO MOVES TO CHOKE OFF FUEL-TAX FRAUD</u>

No new taxes — just no more theft. In the 2027 economic package landing September 9, Sheinbaum will make the fuel tax (IEPS) traceable from port to pump: QR codes on every tanker logging origin, route and depot so the SAT can cross-check imported volumes against the tax actually paid. "We can now know how much imported fuel arrives and where it ends up," she said. The target is huachicol fiscal — the customs-fraud racket that has bled billions from the treasury.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S IMPORT-SUBSTITUTION MACHINE IS RUNNING</u>

While Washington threatens tariffs, Mexico builds. The Second Government Report shows US$987.5 million in fresh investment already approved under Sheinbaum's Plan México — 148 of 173 projects greenlit between September 2025 and June 2026, across autos, pharma, mining, chemicals and agroindustry. The strategy is blunt: make at home what the country used to import, and crack the world's ten biggest economies by 2030.
